items.t: Is ServiceNow A Better Buy Than Atlassian Now?
items.sum: Our Nov 18 look at Atlassian found the stock fell 6.0% on Tuesday, Nov 17, while the S&P 500 lost 1.0%. The company had no news that day. Yet 57 of the 62 other application software companies we track fell too. For that story, see What Explains The Move In Atlassian Stock.
